title: S264 23.4 SIP Header Privacy and Integrity using S/MIME: Tunneling SIP
parent_path: S264 23.4 SIP Header Privacy and Integrity using S/MIME: Tunneling SIP

statements.subject: message
statements.description: These encapsulated SIP requests and responses do not constitute a separate dialog or transaction, they are a copy of the 'outer' message that is used to verify integrity or to supply additional information.
statements.guard_semantics: tunneled message/sip bodies do not instantiate a new dialog or transaction state machine

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If a UAS receives a request that contains a tunneled 'message/sip' S/MIME body, it SHOULD include a tunneled 'message/sip' body in the response with the same smime-type.
actions: include tunneled message/sip body in response with same smime-type
